description: An HTML webpage containing embedded Clojure code for Conway's Game of Life, including core algorithm functions, utility functions, and example grid initialization.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.description: Returns neighboring cell coordinates for a given `[x y]` position.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Computes the next generation of living cells based on current cells.

methods.name: print-grid
methods.description: Prints the game grid to the console.

methods.name: print-grids
